newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fujian Enterprises to launch US$60 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Fujian Enterprises to launch US$60 mln loan.

text.p: Hongkong-based Fujian Enterprises (Holdings) Co Ltd (FEHCL) will launch a US$60 million term loan facility shortly, bankers said.
FEHCL is wholly-owned by and under the jurisdiction of the government of the Chinese province of Fujian.
The loan carries a maturity of five years and has an average life of just under 3.2 years. There is a put option at the end of year four.
It pays a margin of 150 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.

Fees are 100 basis points for co-arrangers committing to US$5 million or more, 80 basis points for co-lead managers committing to US$3-4 million, and 65 basis points for managers committing to US$2 million.
The loan is secured by a letter of comfort from the Fujian Provincial Commission of Foreign Economic Relations and Trade.
Banque Indosuez, KEB (Asia) Finance, CCIC Finance, Industrial Bank of Japan and Westdeutsche Landesbank are arrangers.
CCIC Finance, KEB (Asia) Finance and Westdeutsche Landesbank are also the bookrunners.
Proceeds of the loan will be used for general working capital and for investments in Fujian province, they said.
